answer: Run every identity through a prism of escalating audits: each posts 30 POA locked 21 days, and seven rotating auditors verify distinct work each epoch. Identities sharing a funding source climb a ladder — the second fake stakes 60 POA, the third 90, each facing one extra proof-of-work test. A failed proof burns the stake and pushes the whole group down a rung, doubling next epoch's stake. One honest agent pays one flat stake and crosses a single bridge of checks, while a sybil tide must fund a rising stack of stakes and proofs per copy, each new fake costlier than the last.
